verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.starkbank.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the developer docs, plus a markdown rendition of the API reference at /api.md, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. A downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec adds machine-readable material. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, and evidence of the llms.txt's coverage beyond the probe snippet.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
